class.name: MobaMap3D
class.brief_description: Chunked plateau terrain with integrated map-authoring tools.
class.description: Generates meshes and static collision from [MobaMapData] in 16 by 16-cell chunks. Scene objects remain ordinary child nodes. Runtime navigation is baked on entering the tree. Wait for [signal navigation_baked] before requesting paths. Keep rotation and scale at defaults; the navigation profile uses Y-up world units.

method.name: attach_object
method.description: Attaches a detached Node3D and assigns scene ownership. Used by editor undo/redo. Grounded objects snap to terrain.

method.name: detach_object
method.description: Detaches an object without freeing it and invalidates navigation. The caller owns its lifetime.

method.name: bake_navigation
method.description: Asynchronously bakes terrain and child static colliders. Concurrent requests are coalesced; results from outdated geometry are discarded. Uses radius 0.4, height 1.7, climb 0.1 and maximum slope 50 degrees.

method.name: get_markers
method.description: Returns direct marker children in scene order.

method.name: get_navigation_mesh
method.description: Returns the last baked mesh or null. Check [method is_navigation_ready] before using it.

method.name: get_plateau_level
method.description: Returns the base plateau level at map-local X/Z. Returns zero without data or outside the map.

method.name: get_surface_height
method.description: Returns interpolated map-local surface height. Returns zero without data or outside the map.

method.name: is_navigation_ready
method.description: Returns true when a current bake has completed with walkable polygons. The navigation server synchronizes regions on a physics tick.

method.name: raycast_surface
method.description: Raycasts generated terrain using world-space arguments. Returns position and local_position, or an empty Dictionary. Object scenes are not included.

members.member: Source terrain. Use Map settings in the editor to create a fresh resource.

signal.name: navigation_baked
signal.description: Emitted when a current bake finishes. False means there is no usable navigation. Outdated results trigger a fresh bake and are not reported as ready.
